subject: Murder in Galicia (El crimen de Pazos)
query: is murder in galicia a true story
title: Is Murder in Galicia a true story? Yes: the 2015 Pazos case in Spain
answer: Yes. Netflix's Murder in Galicia (El crimen de Pazos), out Nov. 13, 2026, is a fictionalized drama based on a real case: Isabel Fuentes, 66, was attacked with a hammer at her home in Pazos, Verín, in April 2015 and stabbed to death in her Ourense hospital room on May 8, 2015. Her husband, Aniceto Rodríguez, was convicted.
body:
In 2017 the Ourense Provincial Court found Aniceto Rodríguez guilty of attempted murder and murder and sentenced him to 31 years in total (12 for the hammer attack, 19 for the killing). Spain's Supreme Court upheld the sentence in December 2017. Rodríguez died in A Lama prison in 2018 without finishing it. Reports say he had staged the first attack to look like a burglary.

The series is a short Spanish miniseries from Bambú Producciones, directed by Carlos Sedes and written by Ramón Campos, David Orea, Curro Serrano and Gema R. Neira. Tristán Ulloa plays Elías, a Guardia Civil sergeant, and Miguel Borines plays Aniceto; the victim is renamed Irene.

Netflix also released a documentary on the same case a week earlier: Unprotected: Murder in Galicia, directed by Jorge Laplace, premiered on Nov. 6, 2026. Laplace says its central question is how she could be murdered in a hospital when it was known she was in danger.
